comments.author: @MrCuriousEN
comments.text: What makes the Bijagós especially fascinating is that isolation has preserved social structures that developed very differently from much of the outside world. 🌍🏝 Women traditionally hold important roles in land, family and community decisions, while survival still depends heavily on fishing, seasonal agriculture and knowledge of the tides. It’s a reminder that remoteness can protect traditions, but it also makes adapting to modern pressures far more complicated.

comments.author: @WilsonLauren-z5k
comments.text: Note to self: I need to live a good, honest life so I never end up stranded or forced to adapt to a place this isolated. The matriarchal culture is fascinating, but living under such rigid tribal rules and isolation must be intense. Beautiful doc, but I’m perfectly fine watching this from my couch!
